about: The core tech stack, locked. `core` maps a package to the major version (0.x: the minor) it must stay on; `extra` lists the other packages we allow. scripts/check-stack.mjs fails the build when package.json adds a package that is in neither list, drops a core package, or moves one to another major. To change the stack: write the reason in docs/decisions, then update this file, the Tech stack list in src/app/[lang]/admin/pm/content.ts and package.json in the same pull request. An agent must not do this on its own.
